summary: 1918 47-foot Aermotor tower on Swede Mountain in Hague, Warren County, NY; state closed it in 1968, county-owned, with a public trail reported open in August 2021.

facts.design: 47-foot Aermotor tower; the register says LS-47, the 2023 FFLA grant report says LS-40

access.note: A news report dated August 13, 2021 says the tower is now open to the public; the county trail crosses private land under an agreement with a landowner.

visit.trail_note: 1.8 miles round trip with about 240 feet of elevation gain; the sources do not say whether the tower itself may be climbed

corrections.why: A 2021 news report says Warren County owns the tower and the land around it, and a 2023 grant went to Warren County Parks, Recreation & Railroad. The register's 'administered by' line may be out of date.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 1918, the year the current 47-foot steel tower was erected. The Forest Lookouts history says a lookout station was set up on the site in 1912, so the site was staffed before the tower.
The register names the state DEC as administrator, but the 2021 news report says Warren County owns the tower after buying it in 1995. The state's involvement ended with the 1968 closure.

notes_for_editor: Design model disagrees: the register says LS-47, the 2023 FFLA grant report says LS-40. The brief's 2024 entries (interpretive panels added by Warren County; a roof panel installed before an Aug. 31 lighting event) were not found in any source I read, so they are left out; the roof work's completion is unconfirmed. The register's Administered-by line (NYS DEC) conflicts with the 2021 news report (Warren County owns it); the agency correction is for human review. Post-Star article date is not shown in the text I read, so it is cited only for the trail opening and the 47-foot height. No staffing or climbing status sources were found. Access is public per the 2021 news report, which is five years old; check current status before relying on it. One WebSearch call and eight page reads used on this lookout.
